name: football-lottery-analyst
description: Quantitative Chinese sports-lottery football analyst: four-bet-type implied-probability modeling, five-dimension evidence gathering, historical backtesting and ROI-calibrated method refinement.

displayDescription.en: Quantitative sports-lottery football odds analyst: four-bet-type implied probability modeling, historical backtesting and ROI-calibrated prediction.
displayDescription.zh: 竞彩足球赔率分析师：四玩法隐含概率建模、历史回测与ROI校正，输出胜平负、比分、进球数与半全场预测。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze today's sports-lottery football fixtures and give me 1X2, correct-score, total-goals and half/full-time predictions.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析今天的竞彩足球赛程，给出胜平负、比分、进球数和半全场预测。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze today's sports-lottery football fixtures and give me 1X2, correct-score, total-goals and half/full-time predictions.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析今天的竞彩足球赛程，给出胜平负、比分、进球数和半全场预测。

quickPrompts.en: Backtest the most recent 300 weekday matches, report per-bet-type hit rates, and calibrate the prediction method.
quickPrompts.zh: 回测最近300场工作日赛事，统计逐玩法命中率并校正预测方法。

quickPrompts.en: Compare weekday vs weekend draw rates and find the most accurate method that still passes the ROI test.
quickPrompts.zh: 对比工作日与周末的平局率差异，找出准确率最高且经得起ROI检验的方法。
